title.en: Saturn turns direct, Jupiter turns retrograde: 11 & 13 December 2026 for every ascendant

lead.en: Two planets turn within two days: on 11 December 2026 Saturn turns direct in Pisces, and on 13 December 2026 Jupiter turns retrograde in Leo.

text.en: In the middle of December, Saturn and Jupiter both change direction, two days apart. What actually changes when a planet turns around?

A planet never really walks backwards. From Earth it only looks that way, like a slower car that seems to roll back while you overtake it. Astrologers still read it closely. Retrograde time is for going back over things. Direct time is for moving on with what you have reviewed. Here are the two turns. On the eleventh of December twenty twenty-six, Saturn turns direct in Pisces. It has been retrograde since late July. On the thirteenth of December, Jupiter turns retrograde in Leo, only six weeks after it entered that sign. So the planet of patience starts walking forward again. And the planet of growth stops to look back.
Two turns, two days apart. Is that a coincidence, or are they connected?

They are connected. Saturn sits in Pisces, and Pisces belongs to Jupiter. So Jupiter is the planet Saturn reports to. When the boss pauses and the worker starts moving, plans get built, but they keep getting checked. There is a second link. From Leo, Jupiter's fifth aspect falls on Sagittarius. From Pisces, Saturn's tenth aspect falls on Sagittarius too. So both slow planets look at the same sign this winter. Find Sagittarius in your own chart, and note which house it is for you. That house gets a double look.
How long does all this last?

Jupiter's backward walk crosses a border. On the twenty-fourth of January twenty twenty-seven, it slips back from Leo into Cancer. In Cancer, Jupiter is exalted, at its strongest. On the thirteenth of April, it turns direct there. Saturn meanwhile walks forward through Pisces. On the third of June, it enters Aries. And on the twenty-sixth of June, Jupiter enters Leo again. So this winter brings Jupiter back to its best sign for five months.
Now sign by sign. Aries rising first. Where do the two planets sit for Aries?

For Aries rising, Saturn is in Pisces, your twelfth house. That's sleep, rest, spending, and work done out of sight. Saturn rules your tenth and eleventh houses, career and income. So since late July, career plans may have stalled behind the scenes. From the eleventh of December, they start to move again. Jupiter sits in Leo, your fifth house, and turns retrograde there on the thirteenth. The fifth house is creativity, study, romance and children. Jupiter rules your ninth house of luck and teachers, and also your twelfth. And from Leo, its ninth aspect falls right on you, on your ascendant. That's a protective look, even while Jupiter is retrograde.
So what should Aries do with the retrograde months?

Use them to finish, not to start. Jupiter going back through your fifth house is good for returning to a course you dropped, or a creative project you left half done. On the twenty-fourth of January, Jupiter slips back into Cancer, your fourth house. Home and family come to the front. Jupiter is exalted there, so it's a good window for a move, a repair, or a calm family talk. It turns direct on the thirteenth of April. Meanwhile, Saturn's tenth aspect from Pisces lands on Sagittarius, your ninth house. So teachers, travel plans and big beliefs get tested. Slow, careful answers win here.
And when does it open up again?

In early summer. On the third of June twenty twenty-seven, Saturn enters Aries, your own first house. That's a big chapter of its own. Then on the twenty-sixth of June, Jupiter returns to Leo and your fifth house, moving forward this time. Whatever you reviewed in winter, you can now take further. So, Aries in one sentence: finish what was stuck in December, settle the home front by spring, and step out in June.
Next, Taurus rising. What do the two turns mean for Taurus?

For Taurus rising, Saturn is your best friend among the planets. It rules your ninth and tenth houses, luck and career. Right now it sits in Pisces, your eleventh house of gains, friends and big networks. And its third aspect lands straight on your ascendant. Since late July, income from groups and contacts may have felt slow. When Saturn turns direct on the eleventh of December, those channels open again. Jupiter sits in Leo, your fourth house of home, mother and inner peace, and turns retrograde there on the thirteenth. For you, Jupiter rules the eighth and eleventh houses, so it brings sudden changes and sudden gains.
What is the retrograde Jupiter asking Taurus to look at?

The home front. Old questions about where you live, or about family, come back for a second look. Don't rush a property purchase in December. On the twenty-fourth of January, Jupiter slips back into Cancer, your third house. Writing, short trips, siblings and your own courage get a lift, and Jupiter is exalted there. It's a good time to learn a skill, or to send the message you kept postponing. Jupiter turns direct on the thirteenth of April. All winter, Saturn's tenth aspect sits on Sagittarius, your eighth house. Shared money, taxes and debts want order. Pay them down slowly.
And the summer?

On the third of June twenty twenty-seven, Saturn enters Aries, your twelfth house. Its long walk through your gains ends, and a quieter time of rest and letting go begins. On the twenty-sixth of June, Jupiter returns to Leo and your fourth house, moving forward this time. The home plans you checked in winter can go ahead. So, Taurus in one sentence: collect what your network owes you in December, learn and speak up in spring, and settle the house in summer.
Gemini rising now. Where do Saturn and Jupiter land for Gemini?

For Gemini rising, Saturn sits in Pisces, your tenth house, the top of your chart. That's career, status, and how the world sees you. Saturn rules your eighth and ninth houses, so it brings long tests and slow luck. Since late July, a promotion or a new role may have waited. On the eleventh of December, Saturn turns direct and the work starts moving. Jupiter sits in Leo, your third house of skills, writing and siblings. It turns retrograde there on the thirteenth. Jupiter rules your seventh and tenth houses, partners and career. And from Leo, its ninth aspect reaches Aries, your eleventh house of income.
Which retrograde lesson is there for Gemini?

Go back over your words. Contracts, posts, a course you write or teach, all deserve a second draft. Siblings and neighbours may bring up an old matter. On the twenty-fourth of January, Jupiter slips back into Cancer, your second house. Money, food and family talk come into focus. Jupiter is exalted there, so savings can grow. It turns direct on the thirteenth of April. Through the winter, Saturn's tenth aspect falls on Sagittarius, your seventh house. Marriage and business partners face a quiet test. Keep promises small, and keep them.
And what does June bring for Gemini?

On the third of June twenty twenty-seven, Saturn enters Aries, your eleventh house. Years of effort begin to pay, and older friends may help. On the twenty-sixth of June, Jupiter returns to Leo, your third house, moving forward. Ideas you rewrote in winter are ready to publish. So, Gemini in one sentence: let the career move in December, guard your savings in spring, and share your work in summer.
Cancer rising. Where are Saturn and Jupiter for Cancer?

For Cancer rising, Saturn sits in Pisces, your ninth house of faith, teachers and long journeys. Saturn rules your seventh and eighth houses, so partners and shared money are tied to these themes. Plans to travel, to study abroad, or to settle things with a father figure may have stalled since late July. They get going again on the eleventh of December. Jupiter sits in Leo, your second house of savings, food and family. It turns retrograde there on the thirteenth. Jupiter rules your sixth and ninth houses, so it links work and health with luck.
What should Cancer review?

Your money habits. Look again at spending, at what you eat, and at how your family talks about money. Then comes your best news. On the twenty-fourth of January, Jupiter slips back into Cancer, right onto your ascendant. Jupiter is exalted in your own sign, and you feel it in health, confidence, and good advice from others. It turns direct on the thirteenth of April, still in your sign. Meanwhile, Saturn's tenth aspect falls on Sagittarius, your sixth house. Daily work and health ask for routine.
And then the summer?

On the third of June twenty twenty-seven, Saturn enters Aries, your tenth house. Career becomes serious work, with real duties and real rewards. On the twenty-sixth of June, Jupiter moves on, back into Leo and your second house. The confidence of spring turns into income. So, Cancer in one sentence: unlock your travel and study plans in December, enjoy Jupiter on your ascendant in spring, and build your career from June.
Leo rising. Jupiter is in your own sign, isn't it?

Yes. For Leo rising, Jupiter sits on your ascendant, in your first house. It rules your fifth house of children and creativity, and your eighth house of hidden change. Saturn sits in Pisces, your eighth house of research, insurance and other people's money. Saturn rules your sixth and seventh houses, work and partners. Since late July, a shared financial matter may have dragged. From the eleventh of December, it begins to resolve. Two days later, on the thirteenth, Jupiter turns retrograde right on you. Expect to think again about who you are, and what you want to show.
So how does Leo use the retrograde?

Polish rather than launch. Refresh your look, your health routine, your personal story. On the twenty-fourth of January, Jupiter slips back into Cancer, your twelfth house. That's rest, retreats, sleep and spiritual practice, and Jupiter is exalted there. Charity, or a quiet trip, can do more than effort now. It turns direct on the thirteenth of April. All winter, Saturn's tenth aspect falls on Sagittarius, your fifth house. Children, students and creative work need patience. Results come, only slower.
And when does Leo shine again?

On the third of June twenty twenty-seven, Saturn enters Aries, your ninth house, and asks you to commit to one teacher or one path. Then on the twenty-sixth of June, Jupiter comes back into Leo, onto your ascendant, now moving forward. A fresh year of growth starts. So, Leo in one sentence: sort out shared money in December, rest deeply in spring, and step forward in late June.
Virgo rising. What do these turns mean for Virgo?

For Virgo rising, Saturn sits in Pisces, your seventh house, opposite you. From there, its seventh aspect looks straight at your ascendant. Marriage, business partners and contracts are under review. Saturn rules your fifth and sixth houses, so study, children, work and health all feel its weight. Since late July, an agreement may have stalled. On the eleventh of December it moves again, with clearer terms. Jupiter sits in Leo, your twelfth house of rest, foreign places and spending. It turns retrograde there on the thirteenth. Jupiter rules your fourth and seventh houses, home and partner.
What does Virgo go back over?

Hidden costs and lost sleep. Check subscriptions, travel bookings and bills from abroad. On the twenty-fourth of January, Jupiter slips back into Cancer, your eleventh house of income and friends. Jupiter is exalted there, so gains and helpful contacts arrive more easily. It turns direct on the thirteenth of April. All winter, Saturn's tenth aspect falls on Sagittarius, your fourth house. Home, property and your mother's health ask for care. Fix what is old before you buy what is new.
And the summer for Virgo?

On the third of June twenty twenty-seven, Saturn enters Aries, your eighth house. It's a sober time for taxes, loans and inheritance. On the twenty-sixth of June, Jupiter returns to Leo, your twelfth house, moving forward. That's good for a retreat, or a trip abroad. So, Virgo in one sentence: settle your agreements in December, collect your gains in spring, and keep your finances tidy in summer.
Libra rising. Saturn is a friend to Libra, right?

It is. For Libra rising, Saturn rules your fourth and fifth houses, home and creativity, so it's your best planet. It sits in Pisces, your sixth house of work, health and competition, and Saturn does well there. Since late July, a work problem or a health routine may have stuck. From the eleventh of December, steady effort beats rivals again. Jupiter sits in Leo, your eleventh house of income and friends, and turns retrograde there on the thirteenth. Jupiter rules your third and sixth houses. From Leo, its ninth aspect falls on Aries, your seventh house of partners.
What should Libra check again?

Your circle and your income streams. An old friend, or an old client, may return. On the twenty-fourth of January, Jupiter slips back into Cancer, your tenth house of career. Jupiter is exalted there, a strong sign for recognition and a good boss. It turns direct on the thirteenth of April. Through the winter, Saturn's tenth aspect sits on Sagittarius, your third house. Writing, sales and short trips need discipline. Do the boring follow-up calls.
And from June?

On the third of June twenty twenty-seven, Saturn enters Aries, your seventh house, and faces you directly. Partnerships become serious, and gain structure. On the twenty-sixth of June, Jupiter returns to Leo, your eleventh house, moving forward, and income can grow again. So, Libra in one sentence: win at work in December, rise in your career in spring, and build solid partnerships in summer.
Scorpio rising. Where do the two planets fall?

For Scorpio rising, Saturn sits in Pisces, your fifth house of children, study, romance and creative work. Saturn rules your third and fourth houses, effort and home. Since late July, a project or an exam may have felt heavy. From the eleventh of December, it moves forward, slowly but surely. Jupiter sits in Leo, your tenth house, the top of your chart, and turns retrograde there on the thirteenth. Jupiter rules your second and fifth houses, money and children. So career and family money are linked this winter.
What does the retrograde ask of Scorpio?

Rethink your career moves before you make them. A job offer may come back, or a manager may change plans. On the twenty-fourth of January, Jupiter slips back into Cancer, your ninth house of luck and teachers. Jupiter is exalted there, and from Cancer, its fifth aspect lands on your ascendant. That's real protection and good guidance. It turns direct on the thirteenth of April. All winter, Saturn's tenth aspect falls on Sagittarius, your second house. Watch your spending, and speak carefully.
When does Scorpio feel the lift?

On the third of June twenty twenty-seven, Saturn enters Aries, your sixth house. That's good news. Saturn wins battles from there, and debts and illness are easier to beat. On the twenty-sixth of June, Jupiter returns to Leo, your tenth house, moving forward. The career plan you rethought can now go ahead. So, Scorpio in one sentence: finish your studies in December, trust your mentors in spring, and push your career in summer.
Sagittarius rising. Both planets look at Sagittarius, don't they?

They do, so this winter is about you. Saturn sits in Pisces, your fourth house of home, mother and property. Saturn rules your second and third houses, savings and effort, and its tenth aspect falls on your ascendant. Since late July, home matters may have felt heavy. From the eleventh of December, they slowly clear. Jupiter is your ruling planet, and it sits in Leo, your ninth house of luck, faith and long journeys. Its fifth aspect also falls on your ascendant. It turns retrograde there on the thirteenth of December.
What should Sagittarius review?

Your beliefs and your big plans. A trip, a course, or a teacher may need a second look. On the twenty-fourth of January, Jupiter slips back into Cancer, your eighth house. Exalted there, it helps with insurance, inheritance and research, and it gives a calm mind in a crisis. It turns direct on the thirteenth of April. With Saturn looking at you all winter, take care of your body. Sleep, posture and a simple routine pay off.
And summer for Sagittarius?

On the third of June twenty twenty-seven, Saturn enters Aries, your fifth house, and teaches patience with children and creative work. On the twenty-sixth of June, Jupiter returns to Leo, your ninth house, moving forward, and travel and study open up again. So, Sagittarius in one sentence: let home matters settle in December, stay calm through spring, and go further in summer.
Capricorn rising. Saturn is your own ruler. What changes for you?

A lot. For Capricorn rising, Saturn rules your first and second houses, your body and your money. It sits in Pisces, your third house of courage, skills, siblings and short trips, and Saturn likes the third house. Since late July, your own drive may have felt held back. From the eleventh of December, it returns, steady and practical. Jupiter sits in Leo, your eighth house of change, research and joint funds. It turns retrograde there on the thirteenth. Jupiter rules your third and twelfth houses.
What does Capricorn go back over?

Shared money and old secrets. Loans, insurance, and family inheritance may need fresh paperwork. On the twenty-fourth of January, Jupiter slips back into Cancer, your seventh house, opposite you. Exalted there, Jupiter is good for marriage and partnership, and its seventh aspect falls on your ascendant. It turns direct on the thirteenth of April. All winter, Saturn's tenth aspect sits on Sagittarius, your twelfth house. Spend less, sleep more, and let go of old guilt.
And when does Capricorn build?

On the third of June twenty twenty-seven, Saturn enters Aries, your fourth house. It asks you to rebuild your base: a home, a property, or your peace of mind. On the twenty-sixth of June, Jupiter returns to Leo, your eighth house, moving forward. So, Capricorn in one sentence: get your drive back in December, invest in partnership in spring, and build your foundations in summer.
Aquarius rising. Saturn is your ruler, and Jupiter sits right across from you. What does that mean?

For Aquarius rising, Saturn, your ruler, sits in Pisces, your second house of savings, family and speech. Since late July, money may have moved slowly. From the eleventh of December, it starts flowing again, carefully. Jupiter sits in Leo, your seventh house of partners and clients, and its seventh aspect falls on your ascendant. It turns retrograde there on the thirteenth. Jupiter rules your second and eleventh houses, money and gains, so partners and income are linked.
What does Aquarius review?

Your partnerships. Terms with a partner or a client may need to be renegotiated. On the twenty-fourth of January, Jupiter slips back into Cancer, your sixth house of work and health. Exalted there, it helps you win against problems and improve daily habits. It turns direct on the thirteenth of April. Through the winter, Saturn's tenth aspect sits on Sagittarius, your eleventh house. Gains come, but through hard work, not luck.
And the summer for Aquarius?

On the third of June twenty twenty-seven, Saturn enters Aries, your third house, a strong place for it. Courage and skills grow. On the twenty-sixth of June, Jupiter returns to Leo, your seventh house, moving forward, and a partnership can be signed. So, Aquarius in one sentence: let money flow again in December, fix your habits in spring, and act boldly in summer.
And last, Pisces rising. Saturn is in your own sign.

Yes. For Pisces rising, Saturn sits on your ascendant, in your first house. It rules your eleventh and twelfth houses, gains and losses. Since late July, you may have felt tired, or slower than you want. From the eleventh of December, Saturn moves forward on you, and energy returns step by step. Jupiter, your ruling planet, sits in Leo, your sixth house of work, health and service. It turns retrograde there on the thirteenth. Jupiter also rules your tenth house, so work matters feel personal for you.
What should Pisces revisit?

Your daily routine and your health. An old symptom, or an old work conflict, may come back to be solved properly. On the twenty-fourth of January, Jupiter slips back into Cancer, your fifth house. Exalted there, it's lovely for children, romance and study, and its ninth aspect falls on your ascendant. It turns direct on the thirteenth of April. All winter, Saturn's tenth aspect sits on Sagittarius, your tenth house. Career asks for patience and proof.
And how does the story end for Pisces?

On the third of June twenty twenty-seven, Saturn finally leaves your sign and enters Aries, your second house. The pressure on you lifts, and the focus moves to money and family. On the twenty-sixth of June, Jupiter returns to Leo, your sixth house, moving forward. So, Pisces in one sentence: get your strength back in December, enjoy love and learning in spring, and put your finances in order in summer.
